epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Recorded 2026-10-30T15:21Z (desktop session `040dfd80-c4c9-411b-895c-698e785a6848`).

Label transition: `pm:queue` → `pm:epic` (one replace write, read back: `enhancement,priority:p2,pm:epic,area:studio,domain:server`); linked as a sub-issue of #28130.

Instruction — the maintainer, in a direct desktop session, verbatim: 「相关的issue 你都应该标记 epic，避免被车队认领」. The card is reserved to the epic subtree; no domain seat takes it.

Why it waits: in the same session the maintainer ruled the package-level override direction — 「方向定为包级覆盖：代码和 Studio 用同一机制，定制都进 .custom。」 — and, on the follow-up questions, 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」, which includes keeping clone only as a "new flow like this one" that lands in the paired `<base>.custom` package. This card is re-scoped (or replaced) in the epic's re-plan; nothing is claimed until then.

The label write and the sub-issue link above were made with the maintainer's own account (`hotlong`) from the desktop session before this seat switched to the fleet write tools; this record is the provenance the transition owes.

epic:#28130#1 · hotlong · session_040dfd80c4c9411b895c698e785a6848

Recorded 2026-10-30T18:38Z (desktop session `040dfd80-c4c9-411b-895c-698e785a6848`).

**Re-scoped as N-21 and parked behind the ADR rewrite.**

- Re-parented from #28130 (closed as superseded) to the new epic #28236 as its child **N-21**; title and body rewritten for the ruled direction (clone kept only as "new similar", landing in the paired `<base>.custom`, never package-less). The original 2c body is in the edit history.
- Label transition: `pm:epic` → `pm:blocked` (one replace write, read back), with `Blocked-by: #28237` (the ADR-0146 rewrite) in the body. When the `.custom` ensure door (epic child N-13) is cut after #28237 merges, `Blocked-by:` moves to that card.
- Instruction — the maintainer, in a direct desktop session, verbatim: 「这些卡都可以放回车队开发吧」 · 「注意不能写epic车队才会认领」 (2026-10-31); 「等我拍板的 8 个问题，全部同意」 (2026-10-30, includes Q6 on clone).
